measurements.counts: Cumulative user interactions (click, tap, submit, opening an email link) from the first screen up to and including this step. Typing inside a field is not a click; submitting the form is 1.
measurements.inferred_when: A step is reached through a conditional route or an external page (checkout, OAuth, email) whose clicks are not in the repo
measurements.not_applicable_when: The product has no interactive flow (pure library or API)

measurements.counts: Number of distinct screens or pages from the first screen to first value, both included
measurements.inferred_when: First value is not a single identifiable screen

measurements.counts: Required input fields the user must fill to leave this step. Optional fields and hidden inputs do not count. A password with confirmation counts 2
measurements.inferred_when: Required-ness is enforced only server-side and is unclear

measurements.counts: The user must wait for something outside the product to continue (email, SMS, manual approval, sales call)
measurements.inferred_when: The wait depends on configuration not in the repo

measurements.counts: The first screen after signup shows no data and offers no sample data, template, or demo content
measurements.inferred_when: Content depends on data created by a process not in the repo

measurements.counts: At least 1 third-party sign-in (Google, GitHub, Apple, Microsoft, SSO) is wired in code and reachable from the signup or login screen
measurements.inferred_when: Provider is configured but no button or route reaches it

measurements.counts: Signup rejects some email domains (for example personal email providers)
measurements.inferred_when: Restriction is in an external auth service config

measurements.counts: Number of password rules beyond a minimum of 8 characters (longer minimum, symbol, digit, case, no reuse)
measurements.inferred_when: Rules live in an external auth service

measurements.counts: The user cannot reach first value before verifying their email
measurements.inferred_when: Verification is enforced by an external auth service

measurements.counts: A plan or mode exists that reaches first value without paying and without a card
measurements.inferred_when: Plans come from a billing provider config not in the repo
measurements.not_applicable_when: The product is free and has no billing code

measurements.counts: Card or payment details are required before first value on the default path
measurements.inferred_when: Checkout settings live in the billing provider dashboard

measurements.counts: Lowest monthly price for 1 user on any paid plan, converted to USD per month
measurements.inferred_when: Price is only a provider price id with no visible amount

measurements.counts: A price amount is shown to visitors before signup (not 'Contact sales')
measurements.inferred_when: Pricing is rendered from a CMS not in the repo

measurements.counts: Public pages show at least 1 of: phone number, physical address, named support email
measurements.inferred_when: Footer or contact content comes from a CMS not in the repo

measurements.counts: Device or data permission prompts shown before or at first value (notifications, location, contacts, camera, microphone, calendar, bank)
measurements.inferred_when: Prompt is triggered by a third-party SDK

measurements.counts: Every permission prompt before first value is preceded by a plain-language reason on the same screen
measurements.inferred_when: The explanation text is loaded from outside the repo

measurements.counts: The user can export their own data (file download or export endpoint) from the product
measurements.inferred_when: Export is only mentioned in docs
measurements.not_applicable_when: The product stores no user data

measurements.counts: A documented or token-authenticated public API exists for users (not only internal routes used by the UI)
measurements.inferred_when: Routes exist but no user-facing auth for them

measurements.counts: Distinct terms on this screen from the jargon list that are not explained on the same screen. Jargon list: workspace, sync, seat, integration, agent, AI-powered, align, supercharge, pipeline, webhook, SSO, tenant, plus any term in the persona's pain_points
measurements.inferred_when: Copy is loaded from a CMS or i18n file not in the repo

measurements.counts: The feature sends email, push, or in-app notifications, or adds a badge or inbox
measurements.inferred_when: Sending happens in a job defined outside the repo

measurements.counts: The flow asks the user to invite teammates or create a team before first value
measurements.inferred_when: Invite prompt depends on a feature flag
measurements.not_applicable_when: Single-user product with no team code

measurements.counts: The feature is labelled AI (text or icon) and its label does not state a concrete result for the user
measurements.inferred_when: Label text comes from outside the repo
measurements.not_applicable_when: The feature is not labelled AI

measurements.counts: Smallest font size used for body or action text on public and onboarding screens
measurements.inferred_when: Sizes come from a CSS framework default not visible in the repo

measurements.counts: Body or action text on public or onboarding screens uses a color under WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast against its background
measurements.inferred_when: Background color is not determinable from the repo
